subject: [PATCH v3 04/12] nfsd: don't grant write delegations to NFSv4.0 clients on CLAIM_PREVIOUS

2026-11-24.patch_summary: This patch prevents NFSv4.0 clients from receiving write delegations when reclaiming a file during the grace period, which can cause issues with GETATTR operations. The patch adds a check to the nfs4_open_delegation function for CLAIM_PREVIOUS claims, ensuring that only read-only delegations are granted in this scenario. This fix addresses a problem introduced by enabling write delegation support and is based on a review of existing code comments.
